message.content:
If you mean **“iCloud Control”** as the Mac utility, it was a Finder add-on for **user-controlled selective sync** in iCloud Drive—letting you remove selected files locally while keeping them in iCloud, download them again later, and publish a public link.[1] The project’s own repository says it was effectively made obsolete by **macOS Catalina (10.15)** and is no longer maintained.[1]

If you mean the **Apple iCloud Control Panel** on Windows, Apple replaced that concept with **iCloud for Windows**, which gives access to photos, videos, mail, calendar, files, and other iCloud content on a PC.[6]

If you want, I can also help with one of these specific tasks:
- finding the **current Apple-supported way** to manage iCloud Drive files
- explaining how **selective sync** works on Mac or Windows
- checking whether **iCloud Control** still works on a specific macOS version
